headline: $272M runs through one desk.
writer_headline: $272M Rural Health Fund / Runs Through One Desk
concept: An hourglass whose only passage is one pinched neck: federal sand (with a few technology grains) must pass the DOH Commissioner's desk before landing on an etched map of rural Alaska, most villages still waiting.
motifs: gold sand with ice-blue technology grains
etched Alaska map on the lower bulb

eval_history.fix: map too faint to read, sand crater reads as a heart, flat wall acreage in the type column
slip lines into the crater, remove star-like stray glints, pass-through rail with the layer chain in the empty type column
sand surface still has a faint heart silhouette and slip lines vanish; flatten crater, lit rim, stronger slip lines
shipped: remaining gains judged marginal (slip lines subtle at arm's length)
